claim.claim-text: 1. A thermal energy storage system, comprising an ice brick (112, 711) comprising:

a tube (712) having a rectangular cross-section, the tube (712) further comprising at least one inlet (714A) and at least one outlet (714B) for a heat transfer fluid; a plurality of plate-shaped or box-shaped capsules (715) having a phase change medium therein, wherein the capsules (715) are arranged in stacks (717) inside the tube (712), characterized in that a ratio of the length of the tube (712) to the width of the tube (712) is in a range of 4 to 50; and/or a ratio of a width of the tube (712) to the height of the tube (712) is in a range of 0.5 to 2.

2. The thermal energy storage system according to claim 1, wherein a plurality of ice bricks (112, 711) is arranged in a modular arrangement comprising one or more of: ice bricks that are stacked on top of one another; ice bricks (112, 711) that are laid end to end; and ice bricks that are laid next to one another.

3. The thermal energy storage system according to claim 2, comprising insulation panels (230) designed to be attached over one or more ice bricks (112, 711) according to the modular arrangement of ice bricks (112, 711), wherein the insulation panels (230) surround an outer surface of the modular arrangement but not non-external surfaces of the modular structure.

4. The thermal energy storage system according to claim 2 or 3, wherein the plurality of ice bricks (112, 711) ) is comprised in a structural arrangement of a building selected from one or more of a group consisting of:

5. The thermal energy storage system according to one of the claims 2 to 4, wherein the plurality of ice bricks (112, 711) is interconnected for fluid communication of the heat transfer fluid flowing through said ice bricks (112, 711) via the at least one inlet (714A) and at least one outlet (714B).
6. The thermal energy storage system according to claim 1, wherein the capsules (715) have a concave or recessed shape of their broad-sides.
7. The thermal energy storage system according to claim 6, wherein a narrow flow channel for the heat transfer fluid is created between neighboring capsules (715) of a stack (717).
8. The thermal energy storage system according to one of the preceding claims, wherein a plurality of defined narrow flow paths for the heat transfer fluid is provided between the capsules (715).

9. The thermal energy storage system according to one of the preceding claims, wherein the average length of an actual flow path of the heat transfer fluid from inlet (714A) to the outlet (714B) is larger than a length of the tube (712).
